title: Madhya Pradesh Sambal-linked health assistance Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government welfare-linked support pathway for eligible registered workers and families, with health-related benefits administered under applicable state programmes.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on registration under the relevant Madhya Pradesh welfare programme and current rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Madhya Pradesh Sambal-linked health assistance.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
